title: Saturday Quick Tip
subtitle: The last at-bat
hook: Tying run on third. Do you send in a pinch hitter?
intro: The game is tied in the last inning.
Your newest hitter is up next.
statement: The last at-bat teaches the whole team something.
q1: Do you bring in your best available hitter —
q2: or give the moment to the player in the order?
q3: What will the team remember about this at-bat?
t1: There is no single right way. But kids grow
t2: when they get trusted in big moments.
cta: Coaches — who gets the last at-bat?
ctaLines: Pinch hit. Stick with the order. Call a bunt.
Best bat or share the moment?
ctaPrompt: Share your game habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Tying run on third. Do you send in a pinch hitter?
The game is tied in the last inning. Your newest hitter is up next.
The last at-bat teaches the whole team something.
Your best available hitter or the player in the order. Every team is different.
Who gets the last at-bat? Share your habit in the comments.
